set.body: Design and lower autobiographical interview as a first-class workspace in the same instrument, not as known-source story recall. The exact two-speaker InterviewSource transcript is the observational rail; EpisodeModel is a replaceable projection whose Hypothesized or StructurallyDerived status is continuously visible; DetailAssessment x MemoryAddress is the truthful default matrix grain; AiScoringPolicy is an overlay. Interviewer cue/probe/phase chrome never enters participant memory mass, and phenomenology remains a separate evidence channel. No raw participant prose may render without a provider privacy witness. Block implementation in practice on a typed interview ViewRef, visibility semantics, and privacy-gated provider packet; foreign discussion posts post-01M16KGWSTG7BSCMQW1DF7TD2R, post-01M16KPYF7M06PPVQ0CFHQ810D, and post-01M16KR249C80S6AS65XJ57J6Q are references only, not cross-store dependency edges.
set.title: Autobiographical interview workspace
